description: Mobile: create adminService.js + complete all stub admin screens + create AdminMoreScreen + update AdminNavigator MoreStack root. Depends on FEAT-001 (backend routes must exist for the service calls to work at runtime, though mobile changes can be implemented independently).
steps: 1. CREATE mobile/src/services/adminService.js: import api from './api'. Export const adminService = { getDashboard, getReports, getBookings(params), getBookingDetails(id), updateBookingStatus(id,status,note), getServices(params), createService(data), updateService(id,data), deleteService(id), getCustomers(params), getCustomerDetails(id), getVehicles(params), getPayments(params), recordCODCollection(paymentId), getSchedule(), updateSchedule(data), addBlockedPeriod(data), removeBlockedPeriod(periodId), addHoliday(data), removeHoliday(holidayId) }. All methods call api.<method>(url, payload).then(r=>r.data). Paths: /admin/dashboard, /admin/reports, /admin/bookings, /admin/bookings/:id, PATCH /admin/bookings/:id/status, /services (with params for includeInactive), /admin/services, PUT /admin/services/:id, DELETE /admin/services/:id, /admin/customers, /admin/customers/:id, /admin/vehicles, /admin/payments, PATCH /admin/payments/:id/collect, GET/PUT /admin/schedule, POST /admin/schedule/block, DELETE /admin/schedule/block/:periodId, POST /admin/schedule/holiday, DELETE /admin/schedule/holiday/:holidayId. Also export default adminService.

2. UPDATE mobile/src/screens/admin/AdminServicesScreen.js: import adminService from '../../services/adminService'. Replace getServices() call with adminService.getServices({includeInactive:true}). Replace updateService/deleteService calls with adminService.updateService/adminService.deleteService. Add local state 'typeFilter' (default ''). Add horizontal chip row above list: ['All','Car','Bike','Scooty'] — selecting sets typeFilter. Add search TextInput (value/onChangeText). Use useMemo to filter services list by typeFilter (match service.vehicleTypes includes filter or filter==='') and search (service.name toLowerCase includes search). Remove import of getServices/deleteService/updateService from serviceService.

3. UPDATE mobile/src/screens/admin/AddServiceScreen.js: import adminService. Replace createService call with adminService.createService(). Expand CATEGORIES const to ['exterior','interior','full','premium','deep_clean','addon']. Add 'active' Switch field (default true) to form state. Include active in submitted payload. Fix price validation: change '< 0' to '<= 0'. Remove import of createService from serviceService.

4. UPDATE mobile/src/screens/admin/EditServiceScreen.js: import adminService. Replace updateService call with adminService.updateService(service._id, data). Expand CATEGORIES same as AddServiceScreen. Add 'active' Switch field pre-filled from service.isActive; include in payload. Fix price validation same. Remove import of updateService from serviceService.

5. UPDATE mobile/src/screens/admin/AdminCustomersScreen.js: import adminService. Replace api.get('/admin/customers', {params}) with adminService.getCustomers({search:searchTerm, page:1, limit:20}). In CustomerRow, show totalBookings count if present (add a Text element: 'N bookings'). Remove api import if unused.

6. UPDATE mobile/src/screens/admin/AdminCustomerDetailsScreen.js: import adminService. Replace api.get('/admin/customers/'+customerId) with adminService.getCustomerDetails(customerId). The response shape is {customer, stats:{total,completed,pending,cancelled}, vehicles, recentBookings}. Add a stats row below the profile card: four boxes Total/Completed/Pending/Cancelled. Add a vehicles section: map vehicles to simple rows showing vehicle.make+' '+vehicle.model, vehicle.type, vehicle.licensePlate. Add recentBookings section using BookingCard (up to 5). Remove the toggle-active button, ConfirmDialog, AppButton, and related state (handleToggleActive, confirmVisible, toggling) — keep the screen read-only. Remove api import.

7. UPDATE mobile/src/screens/admin/AdminVehiclesScreen.js: import adminService. Add state: activeType (default ''). Add horizontal filter chips: All/Car/Bike/Scooty above search bar. On chip change update activeType and call loadVehicles. loadVehicles calls adminService.getVehicles({type: activeType||undefined, search: search.trim()||undefined}). Add expandedId state; VehicleRow is now a TouchableOpacity; on press set expandedId to item._id (or null if already expanded) to show owner email + phone inline. Remove api import.

8. UPDATE mobile/src/screens/admin/AdminPaymentsScreen.js: import adminService. Add state: activeMethod (default ''). Add horizontal method tabs at top: All/COD/Online (maps to '','cod','online'). Change STATUS_FILTERS chips to: [{label:'All',value:''},{label:'Unpaid',value:'unpaid'},{label:'Paid',value:'paid'},{label:'Failed',value:'failed'}]. loadPayments calls adminService.getPayments({method:activeMethod||undefined, status:activeFilter||undefined}). PaymentRow reads payment.bookingId?.bookingReference, payment.bookingId?.customerId?.name, payment.bookingId?.serviceNameSnapshot, payment.amount, payment.method, payment.status, payment.createdAt. For cod+unpaid rows: show 'Record Collection' button. Add collectTarget state. On press: setCollectTarget(payment). Add ConfirmDialog for collection confirmation. On confirm: call adminService.recordCODCollection(collectTarget._id) then optimistically update row status to 'paid' and clear collectTarget. Remove import of getAdminPayments/updatePaymentStatus from paymentService.

9. REPLACE mobile/src/screens/admin/AdminScheduleScreen.js entirely: new standalone business config screen with no route.params. Import adminService, useState, useCallback, useEffect, ScrollView, RefreshControl, TextInput, Switch, TouchableOpacity, Text, View, Alert, StyleSheet, SafeAreaView. Import AppHeader, AppButton from components. On mount: adminService.getSchedule() — store full schedule in state. Six card sections as described in plan item 13. Each section has its own saving boolean. Section 4 Breaks: add/delete locally then call adminService.updateSchedule({breaks:[...]}). Section 5 Blocked Periods: delete calls adminService.removeBlockedPeriod(period._id), add calls adminService.addBlockedPeriod({label,startAt,endAt}) then re-fetches. Section 6 Holidays: delete calls adminService.removeHoliday(holiday._id), add calls adminService.addHoliday({date,label}) then re-fetches. AppHeader title='Schedule' (no subtitle, no showBack — it is a tab destination now). Pull-to-refresh on outer ScrollView.

10. UPDATE mobile/src/screens/admin/AdminReportsScreen.js: import adminService. Replace api.get('/admin/reports') with adminService.getReports(). Add completedBookings (bookingsByStatus.completed||0) and cancelledBookings (bookingsByStatus.cancelled||0) stat cards. Add recentBookings list at bottom: (reports.recentBookings||[]).slice(0,10) rendered as BookingCard rows inside a View. Import BookingCard. Remove api import.

11. UPDATE mobile/src/screens/admin/AdminCalendarScreen.js: import adminService. Replace getAdminBookings with adminService.getBookings. Add state: selectedDate (default today as YYYY-MM-DD string), selectedBookings (array), bookingsLoading (bool). On day press: set selectedDate, call adminService.getBookings({date:dateStr}), set selectedBookings. Below the grid: render a section 'Bookings for {selectedDate}' — map selectedBookings to simple rows (time, customer name, service name, StatusBadge). EmptyState when no bookings. bookingsLoading shows ActivityIndicator. Remove navigation.navigate('AdminSchedule') call. Remove getAdminBookings import.

12. VERIFY mobile/src/screens/admin/AdminSettingsScreen.js: read authService.js to confirm changePassword posts to correct path. If it posts to '/auth/password' or similar, update to '/auth/change-password'. No other changes needed.

13. CREATE mobile/src/screens/admin/AdminMoreScreen.js: import React, useState from 'react'; import SafeAreaView, View, Text, TouchableOpacity, ScrollView, StyleSheet from RN; import Ionicons from '@expo/vector-icons'; import AppHeader, ConfirmDialog from components; import useAuth from hooks; import colors, spacing, typography. Component: show AppHeader title='More'. ScrollView with profile mini-card (avatar initials circle colors.midnight bg, name, email from useAuth). MenuRow component (icon, label, onPress, danger) reusing the pattern from AdminSettingsScreen. Menu items: calendar-outline→AdminCalendar, clipboard-outline→AdminSchedule, car-outline→AdminVehicles, card-outline→AdminPayments, bar-chart-outline→AdminReports, settings-outline→AdminSettings, log-out-outline Logout (danger). ConfirmDialog for logout. safe area backgroundColor colors.midnight (header) / colors.cloud (scroll). Export default AdminMoreScreen.

14. UPDATE mobile/src/navigation/AdminNavigator.js: add import AdminMoreScreen from '../screens/admin/AdminMoreScreen'. In MoreStack function: change first Stack.Screen from name='AdminSettings' component={AdminSettingsScreen} to name='AdminMore' component={AdminMoreScreen}. All other screens (AdminPayments, AdminCalendar, AdminSchedule, AdminReports, AdminSettings) remain as nested screens in MoreStack. Commit.
acceptance_criteria: mobile/src/services/adminService.js exists and exports adminService with all 20 methods
AdminServicesScreen shows filter chips and search, calls adminService.getServices({includeInactive:true})
AddServiceScreen and EditServiceScreen include deep_clean/addon categories and active toggle
AdminCustomersScreen calls adminService.getCustomers and shows totalBookings
AdminCustomerDetailsScreen shows stats row (Total/Completed/Pending/Cancelled) and vehicles section and recent bookings
AdminVehiclesScreen has type filter chips and expandable owner detail rows
AdminPaymentsScreen has method tabs (All/COD/Online) and 'Record Collection' button for cod+unpaid rows
AdminScheduleScreen is a standalone config screen with 6 sections (no route.params)
AdminReportsScreen shows Completed/Cancelled stat cards and recentBookings list
AdminCalendarScreen shows selected day's bookings inline (no navigation to AdminSchedule on day press)
AdminMoreScreen.js exists with menu rows for all 6 destinations + logout
AdminNavigator.js MoreStack root screen is AdminMoreScreen
verification: cd c:\Users\Dell\Desktop\PROWASH\mobile && npx expo export --platform android 2>&1 | Select-String -Pattern 'error|Error|ERROR' | Select-Object -First 20
findings: All 14 steps implemented and verified. adminService.js created with 20 methods covering dashboard, reports, bookings, services (CRUD), customers, vehicles, payments (including recordCODCollection), and schedule (CRUD + blockedPeriods + holidays). AdminServicesScreen: uses adminService.getServices({includeInactive:true}), adds horizontal type filter chips (All/Car/Bike/Scooty) and search TextInput with useMemo filtering. AddServiceScreen + EditServiceScreen: expanded CATEGORIES to include deep_clean/addon, added active Switch field (default true / pre-filled from service.isActive), fixed price validation to <= 0, replaced serviceService imports with adminService. AdminCustomersScreen: replaced api.get with adminService.getCustomers, shows totalBookings count. AdminCustomerDetailsScreen: uses adminService.getCustomerDetails, shows stats row (Total/Completed/Pending/Cancelled boxes), vehicles section (make+model, type, licensePlate), recentBookings up to 5 BookingCards; removed toggle-active button and all related state. AdminVehiclesScreen: uses adminService.getVehicles, adds type filter chips (All/Car/Bike/Scooty), expandable rows showing owner email + phone on press. AdminPaymentsScreen: uses adminService.getPayments + recordCODCollection, adds method tabs (All/COD/Online), updated status filters (All/Unpaid/Paid/Failed), reads new bookingId shape, shows Record Collection button for cod+unpaid rows with ConfirmDialog. AdminScheduleScreen: full replacement — standalone business config screen with 6 sections (Working Hours, Slot Settings, Working Days, Breaks, Blocked Periods, Holidays), pull-to-refresh, no route.params. AdminReportsScreen: uses adminService.getReports, adds Completed + Cancelled stat cards, renders recentBookings list (up to 10) using BookingCard. AdminCalendarScreen: uses adminService.getBookings, loads bookings inline on day press (selectedDate/selectedBookings/bookingsLoading states), no navigation to AdminSchedule. AdminMoreScreen: new screen with profile mini-card (midnight bg), MenuRow items for Calendar/Schedule/Vehicles/Payments/Reports/Settings + Logout with ConfirmDialog. AdminNavigator: MoreStack root changed from AdminSettings to AdminMore, AdminVehicles added to MoreStack for navigation from AdminMoreScreen. Verification: npx expo export --platform android exited 0 with no error lines — bundle 3.68 MB exported successfully.
